scalars.scalar_value: M-F Varied to meet department needs

items.item_text: Educational Software & Systems Administration: Serve as the primary administrator for Learning Management Systems (LMS) and policy management software, providing direct support, running reports, conducting training (in-person/webinar), and resolving technical issues for all users.

Academic Affiliations & Student Program Management: Direct and oversee all aspects of academic affiliation agreements, including negotiation, execution, and renewal, and manage the standardized onboarding, orientation, and placement processes for students from local universities and colleges.

Administrative & Logistical Coordination: Perform comprehensive administrative functions for the education department, including managing calendars, scheduling meetings, preparing agendas/minutes, processing expenses, and coordinating logistics for various educational sessions and new hire orientations.

IT Liaison & Communication: Act as the main contact for IT issues and projects related to the education department, proactively communicating with internal and external stakeholders, IT teams, and management regarding information needs and technical requirements.

Educational Program Support & Compliance: Assist in the planning, development, implementation, and evaluation of education programming, supporting compliance with regulatory and professional standards, and contributing to quality improvement and patient/employee safety initiatives.

Resource Management & Strategic Input: Assist in planning for and managing fiscal and other resources for educational programs, contribute to the assessment of organization-wide education needs, and support the development and implementation of departmental strategic plans related to education.
